purpose: Repository evidence for the two independent, strictly read-only audits that adjudicated W2-B3. Audit 1 (focused adversarial closure, at 5273eb7) found the three FIBIU contracts substantively closed but returned FAIL on exactly one blocker, B3-BLK-A. Audit 2 (entrypoint delta closure, at 3f67b47) verified the bounded remediation of that blocker and returned PASS. This artifact records what those audits measured; it authorizes no implementation, no schema change, and no W2-B4 work. It is the reference for source_audit_state.verdict=ACCEPTED in docs/ops/wave2/W2_B3_COMPLETENESS_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json.

audited_authority.sha256_pin_note: This is the hash of the authority AS AUDITED, i.e. before source_audit_state.verdict was set to ACCEPTED. Recording that acceptance necessarily changes the file, so the current hash differs by construction and this pin must not be compared against the live file. It is also the value embedded in docs/ops/wave2/W2_B3_TEST_MANIFEST_v2.json, which was frozen against the same pre-acceptance content.

adjudications.unclassified_reasoning: Derived from baseline FIB authority, not from the remediation prompt. FIBC-015 scopes numerator exclusion to `not_material` only and states that preliminary work is permitted while classification is pending. MATERIALITY_UNCLASSIFIED is one of FIBC-023's 24 enumerated non-eligibility reasons whose OWNING UNIT is FIBIU-19, and FIBC-023's PRELIMINARY state ('calculated but >= 1 eligibility condition unmet') explicitly contemplates a persisted run in that state. Excluding unclassified outcomes from the numerator would contradict FIBC-015 and pre-empt FIBIU-19.
adjudications.hosted_writer_reasoning: The finding is real: on a hosted target the runtime would receive 42501 before RLS is evaluated. It is not B3-specific — stella_hosted_0007 is a closed enumerated ACL predating the FIB era, and financial_proxy_versions, proxy_material_fields_registry, evidence_sufficiency_determinations, fib_audit_log and domain_object_versions are equally ungranted while belonging to already-closed B1/B2. No ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES covers schema public for the runtime roles. DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS protects db/prepared/** while HPO-ODS-W2-01 grants only db/prepared/journal/**, so B3 was structurally barred from touching the hosted package. The defect fails closed (denies access) and is therefore not a security blocker.

inherited_non_blocking_findings.summary: No hosted package grants uellix_writer any privilege on tables created after stella_hosted_0007, including outcome_monetization_dispositions. On a hosted target the runtime would receive 42501 before RLS is evaluated.
inherited_non_blocking_findings.scope: Program-wide, not B3-specific: the same gap covers Wave-1/Wave-2 tables owned by already-closed B1/B2. Fails closed. Owned by the hosted provisioning lineage (db/prepared/stella_hosted_*), outside every Wave-2 batch surface.

inherited_non_blocking_findings.summary: Report and PDF surfaces render the no-ratio state as a bare em dash via fmtRatio(null) rather than an affirmative no-ratio declaration. No fabricated ratio is emitted, so FIBC-016's core prohibition holds, but the in-app surfaces are more explicit than the report path.

Pre-existing display defects on the calculation compare page: the 'Valor Social Neto' row reads totalInvestment, and the side columns for 'Valor Social Bruto' and 'Items de linea' are hardcoded to 0. Present unchanged at fd6e252; not introduced by B3.

The full suite is unstable under full-parallel execution on the development host: 69 of 72 raw new failures measured against base were artifacts (pnpm-spawning tests/ods/** buckling under load, and '(stack reachable)' suites flipping skip->fail because an unrelated worktree's local Supabase stack changed reachability between runs). Every candidate failure must be re-run in isolation before being called deterministic. This noise is what allowed B3-BLK-A to go unnoticed until a real BASE capture was produced.

parseNum on a non-blank, non-numeric filter value would return 0 on the authoritative path. Unreachable in practice because the five governed filter columns are numeric, so PostgreSQL guarantees numeric-parseable text.

W2_B3_ENTRYPOINT_INVENTORY_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json lists non_vacuous_controls_required ['P1','N1','N2','N3','M1'] without defining those labels, and that mission shipped no test manifest. Not counted as an authority gap: required_edits specified the work exactly, the contract is fully pinned by the test file itself, and all five controls proved non-vacuous under the natural mapping.
